Subject: Contracting road map & legal contact kickoff — Foresight Health

Hi Amir + Priya —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. As discussed, I’m kicking off a short mutual action plan (MAP) so procurement and legal have a shared view of milestones and owners. I’ve attached a draft MAP and an evaluation plan with the core test cases we’ll use for the pilot.

High-level proposed timeline (flexible):
- Contract redline & review: Jan 11 — Jan 20
- Security/compliance items & evidence exchange: Jan 11 — Jan 25
- Final SOW + signatures: target Feb 4
- Pilot start / onboarding: Mar 1

Please confirm who on your side is the authoritative contact for procurement and legal (names + emails). On our side: Rafael is the customer success/ops owner, Jordan is the AM for GTM/terms discussions, and I’ll coordinate timelines and signature logistics.

Attachments: Foresight_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), eval-cases.md (evaluation plan)

Ask: Can you introduce the procurement/legal leads by end of day tomorrow? Also let me know if you prefer DocuSign or initial exchange of a redline in Word/PDF.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142

---

Note: If you'd like I can add a short checklist for SOC2 items into the MAP once Lina/Legal are looped in.

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the MAP, that format looks good. Looping in our procurement lead for contracting: Lina Morales (lina.m@foresighthealth.com) — copying procurement@foresighthealth.com so the team sees the timeline. Priya is our product lead and will run the evaluation; she’s copied here.

On process: we generally prefer a consolidated redline (one Word with tracked changes) rather than line-by-line email threads. DocuSign is fine for signatures once both sides have a final SOW. For security evidence, I attached our initial security questionnaire (security-questionnaire_FH.pdf) — can your team confirm what artifacts we should expect (SOC2 report, encryption details, data flow diagram)?

I’ll aim to review the MAP internally today and come back with any procurement-specific constraints (e.g., payment terms, PO requirements).

Best,

Date: 2027-01-11T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contracting road map & legal contact kickoff — Foresight Health

Hi all —

Thanks for the intro, Amir. I’m Neha Kapoor (Counsel, Redwood) — I’ll be the primary legal contact for contract redlines and final review. A few preferences/process items from our side to keep reviews tight: 

1) Please consolidate all redline changes into a single Word doc with tracked changes (we’ll produce a consolidated redline back). We find that minimizes version drift.
2) Our internal SLA for first-pass redline review is 3 business days for standard MSAs, 5 days for custom SOWs with material modifications. If you need expedited review, flag it in the body of your upload and loop Rafael/Olga for prioritization.
3) Please route final documents to legal@redwood.com once procurement confirms commercial terms. For the MAP, I’ll add a short contracting milestone row so legal milestones are visible.

We’ll need confirmation on a couple of items you flagged: data residency (which region will host customer data for the pilot) and whether Foresight requires additional bespoke logging/audit detail. If you can share an initial answer (even tentative) we can note it in the MAP and the SOW.

I attached a short note on our redline guidelines: redline_guidelines.pdf (covers preferred formatting, metadata on the doc, and how to present counter-offers).

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Counsel | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

---

Attached: redline_guidelines.pdf

Subject: Re: Contracting road map & legal contact kickoff — Foresight Health

Thanks everyone — quick update and next steps: 

1) Owners confirmed: Lina (procurement), Amir (platform sponsor), Priya (product/eval), Rafael (CS ops), Neha (Redwood legal). I’ve updated the MAP with these roles.
2) Redline process: Foresight to upload one Word tracked-changes document to the shared Drive folder; Neha will complete first-pass review within 3 business days per the SLA.
3) Security artifacts: Redwood will provide SOC2 type II report excerpt, a short data flow diagram, and encryption-at-rest summary by Jan 18. Rafael will own the artifact bundle.
4) Milestones (updated in MAP):
   - Procurement review & cost approval: Jan 11 — Jan 18
   - Legal finalization & signatures: Jan 19 — Feb 4 (DocuSign envelope will be prepared once redlines are done)
   - Pilot kick-off: Mar 1

I’ve uploaded an updated MAP (Foresight_MAP_v1.xlsx — v1.1) to the Drive link and attached the HubSpot deal for reference. I’ll create the DocuSign envelope (placeholder link below) once we have a clean SOW.

Next actions (short list):
- Lina: please confirm PO/payment terms and preferred invoicing cadence by Jan 14.
- Priya: confirm the pilot success criteria in eval-cases.md (we’ll lock these down by Jan 18).
- Foresight procurement: upload consolidated Word redline to the Drive folder when ready.

If that looks good I’ll mark this MAP kickoff as green and move the deal to "Legal review" in HubSpot.

Thanks —
Olga
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
